english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for systematic surveillance by cameras or other monitoring equipment.

examples.english: The company installed new cameras to strengthen surveillance at the building entrances.
examples.traditional: 公司裝咗新鏡頭，加強大廈出入口嘅監控。
